text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While researching in the library, a 
certain headline in an article 
incidentally caught my eye.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "—Sirius Symboli, race withdrawal?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I picked up the article and read through 
it carefully. It detailed Sirius Symboli's 
past before she enrolled at Tracen 
Academy.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
'Her father is a prominent figure in the 
URA and a passionate educator. Meanwhile, 
the training club she belonged to has also 
produced numerous exceptional horse 
girls.'

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
'The two sides clashed over the 
educational policy for Sirius Symboli. 
This withdrawal from the race seems to 
reflect the aftermath of that conflict.'

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: ...What are you reading so intently?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Whoa there, don't get so spooked. Were you 
reading a book that exciting? Hmm?

text_block_list.name: Sirius's Junior
text_block_list.text: ...*sniff*... Sirius-senpai...!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: ...What's wrong?

text_block_list.name: Sirius's Junior
text_block_list.text: Um... u-um— What... should I do...?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At that moment, the one who came running 
over in tears was a horse girl who seemed 
to be Sirius Symboli's junior.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
According to the junior's story, her 
mother, who was already prone to illness, 
had finally collapsed and was admitted to 
the hospital.

text_block_list.name: Sirius's Junior
text_block_list.text:
The hospital is back in my hometown, so 
it's far... Just traveling there takes 
half a day...

text_block_list.name: Sirius's Junior
text_block_list.text: And I... have a race tomorrow...!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: ...I see. So, what do you want to do?

text_block_list.name: Sirius's Junior
text_block_list.text: That is...—

text_block_list.name: Sirius's Junior
text_block_list.text:
I want to run in the race, but I want to 
visit her too... There's no point in 
running in a race in a state like this 
anyway...!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
There's a proverb that goes, 'He who 
chases two hares catches neither', right?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Yet on the other hand, phrases like 'kill 
two birds with one stone' and 'double the 
gain' exist too. Don't you think that 
makes no damn sense?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: In short— Either is fine. You decide.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
If you want them, take them. Be greedy. 
Chase after both.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
You came to me because you wanted to 
become like that, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
If your own power alone isn't enough, I'll 
lend you mine.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
If you wanna go see your mom after the 
race, but don't have time for the 
post-race paperwork, or need an emergency 
stay-out permit, just say the word.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
I'll smooth over whatever bullshit 
aftermath there is for you.

text_block_list.name: Sirius's Junior
text_block_list.text: ...! Are you... for real...?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Hah, you think I ever go back on my word?

text_block_list.name: Sirius's Junior
text_block_list.text:
...N-No...! I'll give it one more serious 
thought... And then talk to my mother 
too...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sirius Symboli's junior left the scene 
with a refreshed, resolute look on her 
face.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Not really. Those guys just come flocking 
on their own. I just give them whatever 
answers off the cuff.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Besides, if you're gonna pay the piper 
anyway, it's better to decide things for 
yourself, right?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
She's not a kid. I'm sure she'll be able 
to choose for herself.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hearing those words, the contents of the 
article I read earlier flashed through my 
mind.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Though it was in the past, that 
decision to withdraw from the race didn't 
seem to be her own will back then. If so, 
to her—
choice_data_list:
(What is the value of 'choosing for 
oneself'...?)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...I stopped that train of thought. How 
she chooses to live is for her to decide.
